**Finding: compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

Section 12.3 already gives us the preferred outcome: Customer is expressly free to develop, acquire, licence, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier, and conduct business in any field or territory, and Vendor affirmatively acknowledges that Customer has made no non-compete commitment.

Cross-checks performed:
- No "shall not develop/market/sell", "competing product", or "compete with Vendor" language binding Customer anywhere in the document.
- §2.2 (Vendor as "sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services") is a sourcing/exclusivity commitment — that belongs to the EXCLUSIVITY rule and is not flagged twice here (though it does sit in tension with §12.3's disclaimer).
- §12.4 (18-month post-termination non-solicit) is a no-hire term, addressed under that rule.
- §13.4 restrictions (reverse engineering, interference, unlawful use) are ordinary licence-scope limits, not a field-of-use restriction on Customer's business.
